features.name: force-light-mode
features.description: Homepage always renders in light mode regardless of the browser/OS prefers-color-scheme setting; PrimeNG darkModeSelector is set to 'none' in src/app/app.config.ts. Fixes Issue #49.

features.name: gdrive-evidence-subfolder
features.description: scripts/attach-issue-evidence.sh uploads test-evidence zips into a per-issue Google Drive subfolder named issue-<number> under GDRIVE_FOLDER_ID (created on first use, reused thereafter) instead of dumping all zips into the shared root folder. Fixes Issue #51. (A follow-up GitHub-Issue shortcut-file feature was added and then retracted by the issue reporter; the shipped behavior is subfolder-only.)

features.name: app-shell-title-home-link
features.description: Clicking the app-shell title text (labels.common.title1 / title2) navigates back to the home screen in both PC and mobile layouts; the element is a native <a routerLink> with a pointer cursor, so it is keyboard-focusable and screen-reader friendly out of the box. Fixes Issue #54.

features.name: career-table-mobile-tablet-left-align
features.description: Normal (non-header) cells of the responsibility table on the career page (src/app/feature/experience) render left-aligned on mobile and tablet widths instead of the inherited centered text-align from app-shell's .main wrapper; header cells remain centered as before, and PC view is unchanged. Fixes Issue #57.

features.name: print-layout-fixes
features.description: Print/PDF layout: page margins 30mm top/bottom (20mm left/right) via @page; no extra whitespace above the header or below the footer (the doubled html/body print margin and the min-height are removed); the header title prints as plain selectable text (not a link annotation); the career page responsive-table borders and header backgrounds print via print-color-adjust: exact. Fixes Issue #63.

features.name: remove-unused-devcontainer-compose
features.description: Removed the unused .devcontainer/docker-compose.yml (devcontainer.json builds the Dockerfile directly since bf114d7) and updated the stale references in src/server.ts, scripts/export-db.mjs and .dockerignore to point to .devcontainer/secrets.env for local Cosmos DB env vars.
